{{< include _sk/outline.html >}}

## Entries {.i-list-numbers}

One entry per prompt, under a heading for each day: the time on a small
plate, then three to five words for what you asked. A short prompt is
shown as it is. A long one is labeled by the agent's small model, Haiku
for Claude Code and Codex's light model for Codex, in a session of its
own, so nothing enters yours. Labels are asked for the entries in view, a
few at a time, and kept for good, so each prompt is asked about once.

## Going back {.i-history}

Click an entry and the chat glides to that round. As you scroll,
the entry in view wears the accent, so the outline always says where you
are. The panel shares the left side with the [files](files.qmd): one
shows at a time, and one takes the other's place without moving the
chat.
